e.title: EraX-VL（越南保险单据多模态模型）
e.title_en: EraX-VL (multimodal model for Vietnamese insurance documents)
e.title_hk: EraX-VL（越南保險單據多模態模型）
e.summary: 面向保险单据的多模态模型（7B/2B，基于 Qwen2-VL）：OCR 与图像到文本，越南语/英/中
e.summary_en: A multimodal model for insurance documents (7B/2B, Qwen2-VL based): OCR and image-to-text in Vietnamese, English and Chinese
e.summary_hk: 面向保險單據的多模態模型（7B/2B，基於 Qwen2-VL）：OCR 與圖像到文本，越南語/英/中
e.body: EraX-VL（erax-ai，HuggingFace，Apache-2.0，基于 **Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct**）是**面向保险单据的多模态（视觉语言）模型**：从单据照片与扫描件做图像到文本抽取，主干有 **7B 与 2B 两个规模**、含 V1.0 / V1.5 / V2.0-Preview 多个版本，语言覆盖**越南语 / 英语 / 中文**，标签含 insurance / OCR / vietnamese / bcg / image-to-text。其社区热度在保险类模型中相当突出：**V1.0 版本获 44 赞**，是本次 HuggingFace 全量扫描中保险相关模型里最高之一（同族另有 2B / V1.5 / V2.0-Preview 多个衍生与量化版本）。对 RIAA：**保险单据 OCR 是理赔与核保自动化的入口环节**——越南语保险单据（保单、处方、发票）的抽取需求，说明这项能力在东南亚市场有真实落地场景，也提示「多语言单据处理」是区域扩张的实际障碍；池内已有同类但不同环节/语种的条目：[[suture-vlm]]（核保 binder 与保单差异检测 VLM）、[[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]]（中文条款文档解析数据集）、[[insurance-voice-qwen]]（保险语音），EraX-VL 补上的是**越南语保险单据的视觉抽取**这一格；与 [[insurance-agentic-medical]]、[[non-motor-insurance-product-skill]] 等实务环节可衔接。注意：模型卡未提供详细评测指标，采用前需自测。
e.body_en: EraX-VL (by erax-ai, on HuggingFace, Apache-2.0, based on **Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct**) is a **multimodal (vision-language) model for insurance documents**: it extracts image-to-text from document photos and scans, with **7B and 2B** backbones and V1.0 / V1.5 / V2.0-Preview versions, covering **Vietnamese, English and Chinese**, tagged insurance / OCR / vietnamese / bcg / image-to-text. Its community traction is notable among insurance models: **V1.0 has 44 likes**, among the highest in this full HuggingFace sweep of insurance-related models (the family also includes 2B, V1.5 and V2.0-Preview derivatives and quantisations). For RIAA: **insurance document OCR is the entry point for claims and underwriting automation** — demand for extracting Vietnamese insurance documents (policies, prescriptions, invoices) shows this capability has real deployments in Southeast Asia, and points to multilingual document handling as a practical barrier to regional expansion; the corpus holds comparable entries at different stages or in different languages: [[suture-vlm]] (underwriting binder vs policy difference detection, a VLM), [[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]] (a Chinese clause-document parsing dataset) and [[insurance-voice-qwen]] (insurance voice); EraX-VL fills the slot for **visual extraction of Vietnamese insurance documents**; it connects to practical stages such as [[insurance-agentic-medical]] and [[non-motor-insurance-product-skill]]. Note: the model card provides no detailed evaluation metrics, so test before adopting.
e.body_hk: EraX-VL（erax-ai，HuggingFace，Apache-2.0，基於 **Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct**）是**面向保險單據的多模態（視覺語言）模型**：從單據照片與掃描件做圖像到文本抽取，主幹有 **7B 與 2B 兩個規模**、含 V1.0 / V1.5 / V2.0-Preview 多個版本，語言覆蓋**越南語 / 英語 / 中文**。其社區熱度在保險類模型中相當突出：**V1.0 版本獲 44 讚**，是本次 HuggingFace 全量掃描中保險相關模型裡最高之一。對 RIAA：**保險單據 OCR 是理賠與核保自動化的入口環節**——越南語保險單據（保單、處方、發票）的抽取需求，說明這項能力在東南亞市場有真實落地場景；池內已有 [[suture-vlm]]、[[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]]、[[insurance-voice-qwen]]，EraX-VL 補上的是**越南語保險單據的視覺抽取**這一格；與 [[insurance-agentic-medical]]、[[non-motor-insurance-product-skill]] 等實務環節可銜接。注意：模型卡未提供詳細評測指標，採用前需自測。
e.verified_note: HuggingFace 官方 API + 模型卡核实（Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct 基底、Apache-2.0、语言 vi/en/zh、tags 含 insurance/OCR/image-to-text；V1.0 获 44 赞；同族含 2B/V1.5/V2.0-Preview），未实测推理
